name: virtWidth
meaning: virtual screen width, 0x200 (512) written by Screen_Init 0x52a5d9

name: virtHeight
meaning: virtual screen height, 0xf0 (240) written by Screen_Init 0x52a5e2

name: projDist
meaning: projection distance; Screen_SetProjection 0x52a751 stores its argument (Screen_Init passes 0x180)
